name: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowl with Edamame, Broccoli, Carrot & Miso Dressing
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.

Once the water is boiling, add broccoli, edamame, noodles, and salt; cook until veggies and noodles are tender, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under warm water (from the tap); set aside.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lime into a large bowl.
Add miso paste, vinegar, water, oil, and soy sauce to the bowl with the lime juice. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Add broccoli, edamame, noodles, and carrots to the bowl. Toss to combine.
To serve, divide noodles, edamame, and veggies between bowls; sprinkle with sesame seeds. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
